Job Description:
Johnson & Johnson is hiring for a Sr. Product Analyst, PLM – Shockwave Medica l to join our team located in Santa Clara, CA.
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/.
Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments. Ready to join a team that’s pioneering the development and commercialization of Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) to treat complex calcified cardiovascular disease. Our Shockwave Medical portfolio aims to establish a new standard of care for medical device treatment of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease through its differentiated and proprietary local delivery of sonic pressure waves for the treatment of calcified plaque.
Position Overview
The Sr. Product Analyst focused on Product Lifecyle Management (PLM) will work closely with Quality, Document Control and R&D (PCM) business leaders to understand requirements for the PTC Windchill implementation. You will collaborate with business users, project managers, and vendor resources to define requirements and translate them into user stories.
Essential Job Functions
Understand user challenges and system opportunities; translate them into detailed user stories, requirements, and defect reports. Create supporting documentation such as process flows, mockups, and system-specific functional design guidance.
Evaluate requests for technical feasibility and procedural compliance before accepting work into the backlog. Facilitate cross-functional discussion to gain consensus on how to proceed for unique incidents.
Serve as the Product Analyst (PA) by setting priorities, defining scope, and communicating the future roadmap and vision to globally distributed developers, testers, and stakeholders.
Partner with technical and business teams to analyze root causes, assess impact and develop holistic solutions.
Partner with Product and Platform Product Manager(s) to maintain a deep understanding of business processes and priorities, ensuring team delivery aligns with business value and needs.
Identify, manage, and address dependencies across teams while working closely with business stakeholders, and the Product Manager.
Act as a primary spokesperson to business users and program leadership regarding production system status, issues, and escalations.
Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to streamline processes, enhance tools, maximize business value.
Cultivate a collaborative, inclusive, and Credo-based culture by modeling company values and valuing diverse perspectives.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering. or related field preferred.
At least 5 years of experience as Product Analyst delivering technical solutions for business problems by driving alignment between business and technical partners.
At least 7 years of PLM domain experience, including at least 2 years supporting PLM in the medical device industry.
Experience in GxP systems and Computer System Validation in a regulated environment.
Experience mapping business processes and documenting associated requirements.
Experience with incorporating user feedback into backlogs.
Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), and Agile methodologies, such as Scrum, SAFe, and Kanban.
Experience presenting sprint outcomes and solution recommendations in an Agile environment. Experience with project and program management practices
Experience leading junior colleagues, vendor resources. and/or external consulting resources.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to engage executives, cross-functional and global stakeholders.
Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical partners and empower teams to deliver results.
Ability to think strategically and tactically, resolve problems, prioritize effectively, and maintain organization and discipline across teams during delivery.
Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment with agility, adaptability, composure, and sound judgment under pressure.
Ability to work independently and deliver results with minimal supervision.
Additional Information
The Company maintains highly competitive, performance-based compensation programs. Under current guidelines, this position is eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan. The annual performance bonus is a cash bonus intended to provide an incentive to achieve annual targeted results by rewarding for individual and the corporation’s performance over a calendar/performance year. Bonuses are awarded at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis.
Employees and/or eligible dependents may be eligible to participate in the following Company sponsored employee benefit programs: medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, business accident insurance, and group legal insurance.
Employees may be eligible to participate in the Company’s consolidated retirement plan (pension) and savings plan (401(k)).

Job Description:
We are currently recruiting for a Lead Data Scientist for our Healthcare Compliance group. This is a hybrid role based in Titusville, NJ, New Brunswick, NJ, Sao Paulo, Brazil and Bogota, Colombia.
Position Summary
The lead data scientist is responsible for designing, developing, and scaling data-driven, AI/ML enabled, solutions that enhance Healthcare Compliance operations globally. The role bridges compliance, analytics, technology, and business teams to identify opportunities, develop innovative solutions, and operationalize digital capabilities that improve monitoring, insights generation, risk management, productivity, and decision-making.
This role serves as a technical lead for advanced analytics, automation, generative AI, Copilot agents, and enterprise AI solutions supporting HCC functions across multiple regions and markets.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, validate, and deploy machine learning models to identify potential healthcare compliance risks, anomalies, and emerging patterns.
Apply supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques, including classification, clustering and anomaly detection to business questions.
Develop statistical and analytical methodologies to support proactive risk monitoring and risk identification.
Build scalable analytical pipelines and workflows using structured and unstructured data sources.
Evaluate model performance and continuously improve models through monitoring, retraining, and validation.
Query and analyze large complex datasets to create reproducible and scalable data science solutions
Develop and deploy Copilot Agents, chatbot solutions, and knowledge retrieval capabilities to improve efficiency and user experience in our program.
Ensure governance standards are incorporated in analytic work.
Partner with governance, compliance, and technology teams to ensure responsible AI adoption and alignment with organizational standards.
Requirements.
Strong proficiency in Data Science, Machine Learning, and Advanced Analytics to develop predictive, operational, and insight-driven solutions.
Strong proficiency in Python or R and SQL, for data extraction, feature engineering, modelling, automation, and analytics development.
Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering or related quantitative field with 5 years of relevant experience; OR Masters degree with 3 years of relevant experience.
Experience in developing and deploying ML models using common libraries and frameworks
Experience working with NLP libraries, extracting text from documents (OCR), and generating embeddings for downstream work.
Experience in processing and analyzing large, complex data sets for advanced analytics
Experience in leading analytical projects and influencing cross-functional teams.
Experience with AI, Generative AI, and Copilot technologies with the ability to translate emerging technologies into practical business solutions.
Stakeholder Management & Leadership
Act as a trusted technical advisor to global compliance leaders and business stakeholders.
Lead solution discussions, proof-of-concepts, demonstrations, and technology evaluations.
Translate business requirements into technical solutions and drive execution from concept through deployment.
Mentor team members and promote adoption of modern analytics and AI practices.
Education Qualification:
Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering or related quantitative field with 5 years of relevant experience; OR Masters degree with 3 years of relevant experience.

Job Description:
Enterprise Contract Management (ECM) is an organization under Johnson & Johnson Health Care Systems Inc. (JJHCS) where we serve as the Center of Excellence. We deliver best in class solutions for Commercial Healthcare, Government & Regulatory, Systems, Processes and Training, and Risk Mitigation & Governance.
The Contracting Solutions team is accountable for leading current best-in-class process and technology while also driving the overall maturity of Johnson & Johnson and its business units’ sell-side contracting, tendering, and price execution processes. The Application Support sub-area ensures the strong operation of multiple instances of contracting & revenue management systems and their associated ecosystem.
We are searching for the best talent for a Senior Data Analyst, Contracting Solutions in the sub-area of Application Support located in Raritan, NJ!
Purpose:
The Sr. Data Analyst will play a key role in advancing data-driven decision making, supporting analytics and reporting capabilities, improving data quality, and seeking opportunities for process automation and AI-enabled solutions across the commercial contracting ecosystem. This position requires a solid understanding of Model N platforms, commercial contracting processes, and enterprise data management practices, combined with excellent analytical and stakeholder partnership skills.
Are you passionate about embracing technology to solve business challenges while shaping the long-term design of systems roadmaps? We are sure this role will help you to deepen your understanding of the broad J&J enterprise and gain experience in bringing tangible improvements to the organization. If you are a problem solver and enjoy engaging with a diverse set of partners, we know this role is for you!
You will be responsible for:
1. Data & Analytics
Analyze commercial contracting, pricing, rebate, chargeback, customer, and government pricing data to deliver actionable insights, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting solutions.
Serve as a subject matter expert underlying data structures and data architecture across Model N platforms, ensure data accuracy through validation and root-cause analysis, and support platform enhancements and process optimization in partnership with internal teams and external partners.
2. Data Governance & Quality
Support data governance and quality by documenting business rules, data definitions, and data lineage
Assist in identifying data gaps and corrective actions
Promote consistent adoption of enterprise data standards and best practices.
3. Automation & AI Enablement
Identify and advance opportunities for reporting automation, process improvement, AI, advanced analytics, and self-service capabilities.
Partner with business and technology teams to prepare trusted data assets and assess data readiness for emerging digital use cases.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboratio n
Collaborate with project, product, business, and technology teams to gather and document requirements, perform analysis and testing, validate solutions, and communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.

Education:

Experience and Skills:
Required:
5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, pricing systems, or related commercial functions
Strong understanding of underlying data structures supporting commercial contracting, pricing, customer master, contract master, membership, eligibility, rebates, chargebacks, and government pricing data.
Demonstrated experience with Model N data models, integrations, reporting datasets, and enterprise data architecture concepts.
Advanced SQL and data analysis skills, with experience using Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics platforms.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities.
Preferred:
Familiarity with enterprise technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Data Platform, SAP, Microsoft Power Automate, or Appian.
Exposure to AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, or generative AI initiatives
Experience working across multiple J&J sectors, countries, or regions.
Master’s degree or relevant professional certification, such as Project Management Professional, Six Sigma/Lean Belt, process engineering or an equivalent credential.
Familiarity with US Federal Government Contracting

This position may require up to 10% domestic travel.

Job Description:
About Innovative Medicine
Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.
Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.
Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine
Job Summary
J&J Innovative Medicine – Data, Data Science, and AI - Global Development (DDSAI GD) is seeking a Principal Data Scientist to lead end-to-end delivery of integrated analytical solutions for defined clinical-development and trial-operations business problems. This role owns solution definition, delivery, adoption, and use-case outcomes across connected stakeholder groups using ML, GenAI, optimization, and RWD.
Key Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end definition, development, validation, deployment, and adoption of integrated data-science solutions for defined business problems.
Lead predictive modeling, simulations, optimization, and GenAI applications for study feasibility, enrollment forecasting, country and site selection, protocol design, and operational planning.
Apply clinical, operational, cost, and RWD—including EHR, claims, registries, and clinical-trial data—to generate evidence on patient populations, treatment pathways, feasibility, and operational risks.
Lead RWD analytics that inform protocol feasibility, eligibility criteria, recruitment and retention, study design, comparative evidence, and external-control use cases.
Develop LLM-enabled workflows for information extraction, protocol comparison, data harmonization, clinical-concept interpretation, and targeted workflow automation.
Partner with clinical, operational, technology, and data stakeholders to frame questions, manage trade-offs, and translate outputs into adopted recommendations and measurable use-case outcomes.
Apply model-validation, MLOps, documentation, privacy, data-quality, and responsible-AI standards; contribute reusable code, data assets, and technical patterns.
Communicate methods, model outputs, assumptions, limitations, and decisions clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Mentor junior colleagues and strengthen delivery practices across project teams.
Required Qualifications
Master’s degree in computer science, engineering, biostatistics, health economics, biomedical informatics, applied mathematics, or another quantitative discipline; PhD preferred.
At least 5 years of industry experience leading end-to-end delivery of data-science solutions using ML, predictive modeling, optimization, NLP, GenAI, or RWD analytics.
Demonstrated experience defining, validating, deploying, and driving adoption of analytical solutions that inform clinical-development, clinical-operations, or real-world evidence decisions.
Hands-on experience with structured and unstructured clinical, operational, or RWD data, including multimodal modeling and time-series or simulation methods.
Proficiency in Python and SQL, modern ML, optimization, and LLM-development libraries, and reproducible MLOps practices.
Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and technical-leadership skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical development, MedTech, clinical development, or clinical operations.
Experience applying RWD methods to clinical-trial design, including target-trial emulation, propensity methods, survival analysis, or time-to-event analysis.
Experience delivering analytical products or applications used by clinical or business teams.

Job Description:
We are searching for the best talent for a Lead Platform Engineer - PRO to be located in Raritan, NJ
Position Summary
Johnson & Johnson MedTech is seeking a Principal Platform Engineer for the Customer Experience Management (CxM) Professional Relations & Operations (PR&O) domain. This role is the hands-on technical leader responsible for translating the PR&O product roadmap into secure, scalable, supportable, and reusable platform capabilities built primarily on Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Microsoft cloud technologies.
The Principal Platform Engineer will lead solution design and engineering execution for PR&O workflows, data, integrations, controls, automation, reporting, and AI-enabled capabilities. The role will work directly with the Senior Manager for the PR&O commercial platform, the Senior Principal Platform Engineer, architects, engineers, control functions, business process owners, and delivery partners.
The role has domain-level engineering accountability for PR&O. The Senior Manager owns product outcomes, roadmap, prioritization, funding, adoption, and value realization. The Senior Principal Platform Engineer owns cross-CxM architecture, shared engineering standards, and platform-wide patterns. This role applies those standards, identifies gaps, and delivers technically sound PR&O capabilities.
Key Accountabilities
1. PR&O solution architecture and engineering
Translate the PR&O product roadmap and business-process requirements into executable solution designs, technical backlogs, engineering plans, and non-functional requirements.
Design and guide implementation of PR&O capabilities across Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, Microsoft 365, and connected enterprise services.
Define domain models, extension patterns, data flows, integration contracts, security boundaries, and operational requirements in alignment with the CxM target architecture.
Make pragmatic engineering trade-offs that support immediate delivery while protecting the long-term maintainability and scalability of the platform.
Remain sufficiently hands-on to review designs and code, troubleshoot complex issues, validate technical assumptions, and produce reference implementations when needed.
2. Reuse, integration and platform consistency
Apply cross-CxM engineering standards, reusable services, APIs, frameworks, SDKs, platform components, and approved implementation patterns.
Identify PR&O requirements that should become shared platform capabilities and partner with the Senior Principal Platform Engineer to prioritize and establish them.
Prevent unnecessary duplication, custom code, point-to-point integrations, and regional variants when configuration or shared services can meet the need.
Ensure PR&O capabilities integrate effectively with customer, professional, product, contracting, finance, payment, document, analytics, identity, and adjacent CxM services.
Document architecture decisions, reusable patterns, interfaces, dependencies, and technical constraints so delivery teams can implement consistently.
3. Risk, compliance, data and secure engineering
Engineer required privacy, cyber security, records management, auditability, validation, change control, access, retention, and risk controls into PR&O solutions.
Partner with business and control functions to convert policies and controls into clear technical requirements, evidence, monitoring, and support procedures.
Establish technical patterns for data quality, ownership, lineage, access, retention, and appropriate use of professional-relations data.
Ensure solutions meet defined reliability, performance, availability, recoverability, observability, and supportability requirements.
Raise unclear or conflicting requirements early and drive fact-based resolution without overengineering for speculative future needs.
4. AI, automation and responsible implementation
Design and implement AI-enabled and automated PR&O capabilities where they produce measurable workflow, quality, or user-experience improvements.
Apply approved patterns for LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation, agent orchestration, tool calling, skills, context management, human oversight, evaluation, and observability.
Work with enterprise AI teams to implement governed execution, security, privacy, monitoring, discoverability, and production operations.
Use MCP, agent-to-agent, or other interoperability approaches only where approved, supportable, and justified by the use case.
Ensure AI capabilities preserve human accountability and meet applicable governance, policy, risk, and compliance requirements.
5. Engineering quality and delivery leadership
Provide technical direction to engineers, contractors, systems integrators, and product squads delivering PR&O capabilities.
Lead design reviews, code and configuration reviews, technical backlog refinement, release-readiness assessments, and resolution of cross-team dependencies.
Define and monitor engineering measures for quality, reliability, security, reuse, technical debt, release performance, developer productivity, and production health.
Improve delivery through automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment standards, observability, documentation, and disciplined release practices.
Coach engineers and technical leads while creating a culture of accountability, constructive challenge, learning, and continuous improvement.
6. Production engineering and lifecycle management
Partner with product, support, and operations teams to establish release, change, incident, problem, service, and lifecycle-management practices for PR&O.
Provide technical leadership during major incidents, restoration, root-cause analysis, and corrective and preventive actions.
Use production insights to eliminate recurring defects, reduce manual support, improve resilience, and inform platform priorities.
Ensure technical documentation, monitoring, runbooks, support ownership, continuity plans, and operational-readiness criteria are complete before release.
Measures of Success
PR&O releases meet approved architecture, security, compliance, quality, operational-readiness, and non-functional requirements.
Reusable CxM services and patterns are adopted, and unnecessary PR&O-specific customization and point-to-point integration are reduced.
Engineering risks, dependencies, technical debt, and production issues are visible early and resolved through clear ownership and decisions.
PR&O capabilities are reliable, observable, supportable, and capable of scaling across global and regional use cases.
AI and automation capabilities move beyond demonstrations into governed, measurable, production-ready services.
Product leaders no longer need to mediate routine technical decisions between engineering teams and delivery partners.
Required Qualifications
7 or more years of software engineering experience delivering enterprise-scale products, platforms, integrations, or distributed systems.
4 or more years as a lead engineer, solution architect, principal engineer, or technical lead accountable for solution design and engineering execution.
Deep expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 architecture, configuration, extensibility, integration, data, security, release management, and platform operations.
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, Copilot, and Copilot Studio integrations.
Experience designing reusable APIs, services, components, frameworks, or integration patterns rather than only standalone applications.
Hands-on experience with modern engineering practices and tooling, including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, containers, Kubernetes, and platform observability.
Experience designing or implementing production AI solutions using LLM integration, agents, RAG, tool calling, context engineering, evaluation, observability, security, and governance.
Experience engineering systems in a regulated, security-conscious, or otherwise complex enterprise environment.

Job Description:
We are searching for the best talent for a ​Global Platform Engineer – Sales CPQ PRO AMP to be located in Raritan, NJ
Position Summary
Johnson & Johnson MedTech is seeking a Senior Principal Platform Engineer to serve as the global technical leader for the Customer Experience Management (CXM) platform supporting Sales, Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ), and Professional Relations & Operations (PR&O). The role is based in Raritan, New Jersey.
The MedTech commercial transformation is bringing Sales, Marketing, CPQ, PR&O, Customer Service, and Service & Repair capabilities into a connected, AI-enabled customer engagement ecosystem built primarily on Microsoft Dynamics and Microsoft cloud technologies. This role has direct technical accountability for the Sales, CPQ, and PR&O platform domains and will establish patterns that enable interoperability with adjacent CXM capabilities and the broader J&J technology ecosystem.
This person will be the senior technical counterpart to product and business leadership. They will translate product strategy and business priorities into an executable platform architecture, establish engineering standards across delivery teams and partners, and ensure that each release strengthens a durable global platform rather than creating isolated solutions.
Key Accountabilities
1. Platform architecture and technical roadmap
Define and evolve the target architecture and multi-year technical roadmap for the Butterfly CXM platform, with direct accountability for Sales, CPQ, and PR&O.
Establish clear platform boundaries, extension patterns, data flows, integration contracts, identity and access patterns, and non-functional requirements.
Ensure architecture decisions support global scale, security, privacy, regulatory requirements, reliability, performance, maintainability, and controlled regional variation.
Make pragmatic technology trade-offs that balance immediate release needs with the long-term health of the platform.
2. Reusable platform capabilities and developer experience
Define and lead the development of reusable APIs, services, integration patterns, frameworks, SDKs, components, and developer tooling used across CxM product pods.
Establish governed patterns for Microsoft Dynamics configuration, customization, integration, data access, testing, release management, and environment management.
Create and maintain a catalog of approved platform services, reusable business capabilities, technical patterns, and implementation guidance.
Improve developer productivity and delivery quality through automation, standardization, observability, and modern software engineering practices.
3. AI and agent engineering
Define the technical approach for embedding AI and agent-based capabilities into priority commercial workflows across Sales, CPQ, and PR&O.
Lead reusable patterns for agent orchestration, tool calling, skills, context management, retrieval-augmented generation, human oversight, evaluation, and lifecycle management.
Partner with enterprise AI platform teams to implement governed execution, security controls, observability, discoverability, and production operations.
Advance interoperability patterns, including Model Context Protocol and agent-to-agent integration, where they are appropriate, approved, and valuable.
4. Engineering governance and delivery leadership
Own CXM platform engineering standards and technical guardrails while aligning with enterprise architecture, cloud, cyber security, privacy, data, and AI policies.
Provide technical direction and quality oversight across internal engineers, product pods, contractors, systems integrators, and strategic technology partners.
Lead architecture reviews, resolve cross-team technical dependencies, and intervene early when delivery choices create platform risk or unnecessary duplication.
Coach engineers and technical leads, strengthen engineering capability, and create a culture of accountability, reuse, documentation, and continuous improvement.
Communicate architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, and investment needs clearly to product, business, technology, and executive stakeholders.
Measures of Success
A clear target architecture and sequenced engineering roadmap are established and used to guide investment and delivery decisions.
Product pods adopt common engineering standards, integration contracts, and reusable platform capabilities.
Duplicated solutions and one-off regional implementations are reduced in favor of governed reuse and configuration.
Platform reliability, security, release quality, developer productivity, and time to deliver improve through measurable engineering practices.
Priority AI capabilities progress from demonstrations to secure, observable, supportable production services with defined business outcomes.
Technical decisions are made at the right level without requiring product leadership to mediate routine architecture and engineering issues.

Deep expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 architecture, extensibility, integration, data models, security, release management, and platform operations.
Experience with Microsoft Azure services and integrations across Microsoft 365, including Teams, Outlook, Copilot, and Copilot Studio.
Proven experience designing reusable APIs, services, frameworks, SDKs, engineering patterns, or internal developer capabilities rather than only standalone applications.
Hands-on understanding of modern engineering practices and tooling, including Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containers, Kubernetes, automated testing, and platform observability.
Experience designing or implementing production AI solutions using capabilities such as LLM integration, agent orchestration, RAG, tool calling, context engineering, evaluation, observability, security, and governance.
Experience operating in a highly regulated, security-conscious, or otherwise complex enterprise environment.
Strong understanding of commercial business processes such as sales, pricing, quoting, contracting, customer engagement, or professional relations.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across product, engineering, enterprise architecture, security, vendors, and senior stakeholders.
Experience providing technical leadership to employees, contractors, delivery partners, or federated engineering teams.

The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise data engineering, architecture, analytics, and AI, with deep expertise in Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, Data Mesh, Data Federation, Data Modeling, Data Governance, Enterprise Data Management, Generative AI, and Agentic AI platforms.

Define and own the overall engineering strategy, technology architecture, roadmap, and technical direction for the product in partnership with Product Owners, Product Group Engineers, and Business Unit Architects.
Ensure technical implementations align with enterprise architecture standards, business objectives, economic frameworks, and long-term technology strategy.
Partner with business stakeholders to shape product vision, define capabilities, and translate business requirements into scalable data, analytics, and AI solutions.

Evaluate solution alternatives, validate concepts with stakeholders, and drive informed technology decisions.
Collaborate across product and platform teams to maximize reuse, standardization, and platform adoption while minimizing redundant solutions.
Lead technical planning and governance across multiple squads, ensuring consistency in architecture, engineering practices, scalability, and maintainability.
Drive adoption of modern engineering practices that improve reliability, performance, security, observability, and delivery quality.
Own technology lifecycle management, including APIs, data interfaces, integration patterns, and platform modernization initiatives.
Research emerging technologies and industry trends, conducting innovation spikes and pilots to identify opportunities for business value.
Support Product Owners and Lead Engineers in backlog prioritization and technical debt management.
Mentor engineers and technical leaders while fostering a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Manage technical risks, dependencies, impediments, and cross-product integration challenges.
Serve as the primary technical point of contact for ISRM, Quality and Compliance (Q-CSV), vendors, enterprise platform teams, and external partners.
AI, GenAI & Agentic AI Leadership
Lead the design and implementation of enterprise Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions leveraging Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Microsoft Fabric AI capabilities, Databricks AI/ML, and enterprise knowledge platforms.
Design and operationalize scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, vector databases, semantic search capabilities, knowledge graphs, and enterprise document intelligence platforms.
Build and govern AI-ready data products that provide trusted, secure, and contextualized data for AI applications.
Establish standards for prompt engineering, model evaluation, observability, guardrails, responsible AI, performance monitoring, and AI lifecycle management (LLMOps/MLOps).
Develop scalable AI data pipelines supporting embedding creation, vectorization, document ingestion, multimodal processing, and unstructured data management.
Partner with business, analytics, digital, and experience teams to identify and prioritize high-impact AI use cases that drive measurable business outcomes.
Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise security, privacy, governance, regulatory, and responsible AI requirements.
Evaluate emerging foundation models, copilots, AI agents, and AI platforms, driving adoption where business value can be demonstrated.

Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise-scale data products, data platforms, and data pipelines using Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and modern cloud-native architectures.
Design and implement Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Product, and Data Sharing architectures supporting enterprise analytics and AI workloads.
Enable governed analytics and semantic modeling practices through Power BI, including performance optimization, security, scalability, and model governance.
Apply Data Mesh principles and federated governance approaches to support domain-driven ownership and scalable enterprise data ecosystems.
Establish and enforce enterprise-wide data modeling standards, including conceptual, logical, physical, dimensional, canonical, and domain-oriented data models.
Implement robust data governance practices, including data quality management, metadata management, lineage, master data integration, security, and access controls.
Develop scalable data architectures supporting both structured and unstructured data required for advanced analytics and AI applications.
Enable interoperability and data product consumption through APIs, event-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
AI Engineering Expertise
Demonstrate deep, hands-on expertise with Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, AI agents, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and enterprise AI architectures.
Design and operate enterprise AI engineering platforms, including MLOps, LLMOps, model governance, model evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI controls.
Architect and support AI-ready data foundations that enable trusted, scalable, and governed enterprise AI solutions.

Leadership Skills and Behaviors
Creates a culture that relentlessly focuses on improving outcomes for customers, employees, and the communities we serve.
Leads and influences technical teams across multiple squads, functions, geographies, and experience levels.
Demonstrates commitment to Our Credo, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion by fostering an environment where diverse talent can thrive.
Brings a strong customer-centric mindset and ensures the delivery of products that anticipate and address customer needs.
Establishes trusted partnerships with architects, engineering leaders, product leaders, and business stakeholders.
Coaches, develops, and mentors engineering talent while promoting accountability, ownership, and innovation.
Product / Digital Expertise
Extensive experience leading Agile delivery organizations, including product development, governance, standards, and organizational change management.
Deep technical expertise across Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, Data Mesh, Data Federation, Data Modeling, Data Governance, Enterprise Data Management, AI Engineering, and Generative AI technologies.
Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, API-first design, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
Expertise with modern SDLC practices, CI/CD pipelines, test automation, DevOps, containerization, Infrastructure as Code, and platform engineering.
Proven ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and guide teams toward scalable, maintainable solutions.
Domain Expertise
Experience leading the selection, implementation, integration, and operation of enterprise data, analytics, AI, and digital platforms.
Strong experience managing products and platforms throughout their lifecycle in complex, multi-team environments.
Deep understanding of enterprise delivery practices including planning, dependency management, governance, compliance, quality management, and operational excellence.
Ability to align technology investments with business strategy, value drivers, and industry trends.
Demonstrated success driving measurable business outcomes through data, analytics, and AI solutions.
Required Qualifications

15+ years of experience in enterprise data engineering, technical architecture, analytics, AI platforms, and cloud engineering.
Proven experience leading architecture decisions, technical strategy, and engineering standards across multiple teams and products.
Hands-on expertise with Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, and modern cloud-native technologies.
Strong experience with Data Mesh, Data Federation, Data Products, Data Modeling, Data Governance, and Enterprise Data Management disciplines.
Demonstrated expertise with Generative AI technologies including LLMs, RAG, vector databases, AI agents, prompt engineering, and enterprise AI architectures.
Experience implementing MLOps, LLMOps, Responsible AI, model governance, and AI operationalization frameworks.
Strong understanding of structured and unstructured data architectures supporting enterprise AI and intelligent automation.
Exceptional communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to lead through ambiguity and drive alignment across business and technology organizations.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience operating in highly regulated industries with stringent security, privacy, compliance, and quality requirements.
Experience partnering with ISRM, Quality & Compliance organizations, and audit functions to ensure operational readiness and control compliance.
Experience with enterprise knowledge management platforms, document intelligence solutions, and semantic technologies.
Familiarity with knowledge graphs, graph databases, vector platforms, enterprise search, and advanced AI retrieval strategies.
Demonstrated experience establishing engineering observability, reliability engineering practices, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and operational excellence frameworks.
Experience driving measurable business outcomes and value realization through enterprise data and AI initiatives.
Experience leading enterprise AI transformation programs, AI platform strategy, and adoption of emerging AI technologies at scale.

Job Description:
Johnson & Johnson is hiring for a Comm Ops Data Engineer – Shockwave Medica l to join our team. The position is FULLY REMOTE and can sit anywhere in the US .
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/.
Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments. Ready to join a team that’s pioneering the development and commercialization of Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) to treat complex calcified cardiovascular disease. Our Shockwave Medical portfolio aims to establish a new standard of care for medical device treatment of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease through its differentiated and proprietary local delivery of sonic pressure waves for the treatment of calcified plaque.
Position Overview
Johnson & Johnson is a leading innovator in cardiovascular medical technology, committed to transforming patient outcomes through cutting-edge solutions. Our mission is to improve lives by developing and delivering pioneering treatments that address critical cardiovascular conditions.
As a Data Engineer reporting to the Sr. Manager, Data Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in enabling our business groups to access and interpret meaningful data. You will need to bridge detailed knowledge of our data with an understanding of end users’ needs, crafting accessible, well-structured data for reporting, advanced analytics, and use in AI modeling.
Essential Job Functions
Develop and maintain SQL-based data pipelines to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from enterprise data warehouses.
Aid in semantic model and view development within Snowflake to enable advanced, self-service analytics aligned to the newest analytical practices.
Collaborate with team members to understand data needs and provide technical solutions.
Experiment with new data engineering techniques and tools, embracing the unknown to drive innovation and improvement.
Monitor data systems and implement enhancements driving performance and efficiency.
Coordinate with IT to ensure seamless flow of data across systems, maintaining high standards of data availability and security.
This is a hybrid/remote role, depending on location and business needs.
Travel up to 20% may be required for business needs.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar technical role.
Expertise in SQL and ETL tools for data transformation and warehouse management.
Experience working with Snowflake, Streamlit experience a plus
Understanding of Power BI or other business intelligence tools.
Familiarity with data governance, security, and compliance best practices.
Propensity to problem-solving and ability to optimize data applications.
Understanding of Python, R, or other scripting languages.
Biotech, Medical Device, Medtech, Life Sciences experience a plus
